# lauren-di

> `lauren-di` is a standalone dependency-injection container for Python 3.10+.
> It does one thing: dependency injection. Explicit registration, typed scopes
> (`TRANSIENT < REQUEST < SINGLETON`), lifecycle hooks, opt-in module visibility
> and build-time overrides. Standard library only, no runtime dependencies, PEP
> 561 typed. Import name `lauren_di`. It contains no ASGI layer, no routing, no
> request objects, no extractors, no configuration system and no scheduler.

## Minimal example

```python
from lauren_di import DIContainer, injectable


@injectable()
class Repo:
    def all(self) -> list[str]:
        return ["a"]


@injectable()
class Service:
    repo: Repo


async def main() -> None:
    container = DIContainer()
    container.register(Repo)
    container.register(Service)
    container.compile()
    await container.startup()
    service = await container.resolve(Service)
    await container.shutdown()
```

## How to use this file

`llms.txt` is the map. [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) is the corpus: one section
per public symbol with a signature and a runnable example.

## Guides

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install, declare, register, compile,
  resolve, tear down.
- [Providers and injection](docs/guides/providers.md): constructor, class-body field
  and function providers; what the container refuses to collect.
- [Scopes and lifecycle](docs/guides/scopes.md): the narrowing rule, request
  scopes, hook ordering, teardown error containment.
- [Custom providers and tokens](docs/guides/custom-providers.md): `Token`, `Inject`,
  `OptionalDep`, `Depends`, the four `use_*` recipes, multi-bindings.
- [Module visibility](docs/visibility.md): `owning_module`, `set_visible`,
  `grant_visible`, `visible_in`, `explain`.
- [Testing and overrides](docs/guides/testing.md): `OverridePlan`,
  `ProviderOverride`, `building_with`, the pytest fixture pattern.
- [Recipes](docs/recipes.md): complete programs for the common jobs — configuration,
  a request unit of work, per-build substitution, protocols, plugin lists.
- [Errors](docs/errors.md): the full catalogue with stable `code` values.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): start from the error you are holding —
  every `code`, its cause and the one-line fix.
- [Async and concurrency](docs/concurrency.md): event loops, tasks, threads, the
  request cache and what it does not promise.
- [Design notes](docs/design.md): why the rules are load-bearing, what is deliberately
  absent, and the five recorded divergences from the framework.
- [Migration from lauren](docs/migration.md): symbol mapping and the marker renames.
- [Reference](docs/reference.md): every exported name, with its signature.

## Public surface (`lauren_di.__all__`)

Container and scopes: `DIContainer`, `ResolutionScope`, `Scope`.

Declarations: `injectable`, `injectable_meta`, `post_construct`, `pre_destruct`,
`Depends`, `Inject`, `OptionalDep`, `InjectableMeta`.

Records and aliases: `Provider`, `CustomProvider`, `Token`, `Owner`, `Grant`.

Recipes: `use_value`, `use_class`, `use_factory`, `use_existing`.

Overrides: `OverridePlan`, `ProviderOverride`, `building_with`,
`active_override_plan`.

Errors: `DIError`, `CircularDependencyError`, `DIScopeViolationError`,
`DecoratorUsageError`, `DestructError`, `DuplicateBindingError`,
`InvalidProviderError`, `LifecycleConfigError`, `LifecycleViolationError`,
`MetadataInheritanceError`, `MissingProviderError`, `OverrideError`,
`ProtocolAmbiguityError`, `UnresolvableParameterError`.

## Invariants an agent must not break

1. `container.compile()` validates; `resolve()` dispatches. Misuse fails before
   traffic, not on the request path.
2. `Scope` order is load-bearing: a consumer may not outlive its dependency
   (`SINGLETON` depending on `REQUEST` is an error).
3. `@post_construct` runs bases-first, `@pre_destruct` runs subclasses-first, and
   hooks across a hierarchy must use distinct method names.
4. `Inject(token)` is `Annotated` metadata only; as a default value it injects
   nothing.
5. `OptionalDep(token)` is only valid inside a `use_factory(injects=...)` list.
6. Visibility is opt-in. Without `set_visible`/`grant_visible` the registry is
   flat and `owning_module` is inert.
7. `building_with(plan)` wraps registration, not resolution.
8. Every exception subclasses `DIError` and carries a stable `code`.
9. No runtime dependencies. Standard library only.
